notes.title: New Patch in the Works for Lilith Rising: Season 2!
notes.content:
Hey adventurers,  

We’re thrilled to share not just one but TWO exciting updates with you!  
[hr][/hr]
First, let’s talk about *Lilith Rising: Season 2*. A brand-new patch is in development, and it’s packed with steamy upgrades:  

[list]  
[*] [b]New Sex Animations:[/b] Fresh, high-quality animations will heat things up like never before.  
[*] [b]Voice Acting:[/b] These animations will now include voiceovers, bringing an even deeper level of immersion to your experience.  
[/list]  
But that’s not all…  

Jubei Games is also hard at work on the next installment in the Lilith Rising saga: [b]Lilith Rising Valhalla![/b]  
To give you a taste of what’s to come, here’s a sneak peek at the design of the main menu currently in development:  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914940/b4860d79826059c6850f1e1565b6bd26d84f0f73.png[/img]
We’re pouring our passion into this next chapter, and we can’t wait to share more details with you in the future!  
[hr][/hr]
[h3] Join the Conversation [/h3]  
Want to share your thoughts or feedback? Join the discussions on our Steam Community page ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2864850/discussions/]here[/url]) or hop onto our Discord server to connect with other fans and the development team directly.  

[url=https://discord.gg/8j3NkHD2qt style=button]Join Our Discord[/url]  

[hr][/hr]  

Thank you for being part of the Lilith Rising adventure. Stay tuned for more updates on both Season 2 and Valhalla!  

Warm regards,  
Jubei Games

We’re happy to announce that Hotfix 2.0.15s is now live, addressing the [b]crash bug that appeared with older saves[/b]. The issue has been fixed, so you can now continue your journey without interruptions!  

[h3]Exciting News for the Next Update[/h3]  
From Jubei:  
[i]"We’re working on a huge update that will add [b]new climax animations and voiceovers[/b] for the sex scenes. However, this will take us some time to finish, so expect it to drop [b]around the end of the month or the start of next month[/b]."[/i]

Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Lilith Rising: Season 2 – Major Update & Important Crash Fix Notice
notes.content:
[h1] Lilith Rising: Season 2 – Patch Notes and Known Issues [/h1]  

Dear Adventurers,  

The Jubei Games team has been hard at work improving *Lilith Rising: Season 2* to deliver an even better gameplay experience! This update brings several fixes and enhancements to the game. Here's what's new:  

[hr][/hr]  

[h2] [b] What's New [/b] [/h2]  

[list]  
[*] [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Resolved most visual glitches, and achievements now unlock correctly.  
[*] [b]Translation Overhaul:[/b] All in-game text has been thoroughly proofread and retranslated for a smoother and more immersive experience.  
[*] [b]Text-Image Sync:[/b] Dialogue and visuals are now perfectly aligned for seamless storytelling.  
[/list]  

[hr][/hr]  

[h2] [b] Known Issue – Crash After Mage Tower Mission [/b] [/h2]  

We are aware of a crash issue that occurs after the Mage Tower mission. This happens when loading a save made before this update. Please rest assured that we are actively working to identify and fix the root cause of this bug.  

[b][u]Our Recommendation:[/u][/b] To fully enjoy the updated content, we strongly encourage players to restart the game and experience the polished story from the beginning. This update significantly improves the game, and the refined narrative is absolutely worth revisiting!  

[b][u]Quick Fix:[/u][/b] If you prefer not to restart, you can use the "Skip" feature (hold [b]Ctrl[/b] key) to fast-forward to where you left off.  

We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience and understanding as we continue to improve the game.  

[hr][/hr]  

[h2] [b] Join the Discussion! [/b] [/h2]  

If you encounter other issues or have suggestions, please visit our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2864850/discussions/]Community Discussions page[/url]. Your feedback is vital to helping us make *Lilith Rising: Season 2* even better!  

Want to stay updated or interact with other players? Join our [url=https://discord.gg/8j3NkHD2qt style=button]Discord server[/url]!  

[hr][/hr]  

Thank you for your ongoing support, and we hope you enjoy your adventures in *Lilith Rising*!

notes.title: Lilith Rising: Season 2 - Patch 2.0.13s Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Lilith Rising: Season 2 – Patch Notes[/h1]  

Adventurers,  

We’re excited to share that the latest patch for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2424440/Lilith_Rising__Season_1/]Lilith Rising: Season 2[/url] is now live! This update focuses on improving the overall experience with key fixes and adjustments:  

[olist]  
[*][b]Visual Bug Fixes:[/b] Resolved several graphical issues to ensure a smoother and more immersive adventure.  
[*][b]Proofreading Overhaul:[/b] We've polished the text to eliminate typos, improve readability, and enhance the flow of the story.  
[*][b]Text-to-Image Sync:[/b] Adjusted scenes to better align dialogue with visuals, making every moment more cohesive.  
[*][b]Chinese Localization Improvements:[/b] Fine-tuned the translation to closely match the original script, ensuring a high-quality experience for Chinese players. 🀄  
[/olist]  

We’re grateful for your continued feedback and support as we refine and perfect [i]Lilith Rising: Season 2[/i]. If you notice anything else that needs our attention, feel free to share your feedback in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2864850/discussions/]community discussions[/url] or join the conversation in our [url=https://discord.gg/8j3NkHD2qt]Discord server[/url]!  

Enjoy the update, and may your journey through the kingdom be as epic as ever! 💖  

[hr][/hr]  
[b]— Jubei Games[/b]
